evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where the roadmap evolves and ownership is broad.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD balances explicit fast-moving/high-growth language with rigor-focused phrases like "analytically rigorous" and "improves data quality," giving a mixed signal.
evidence.domain_risk: Develop outputs that help internal and partner-facing teams prioritize effort, identify risk and opportunity, and act with greater precision.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect partner-facing commercial decisions and revenue operations without regulatory or financial-reporting exposure, placing this at moderate risk.
evidence.collaboration_width: Revenue Operations; Sales; Marketing Ops; partnership and commercial teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: you won't just track partner performance—you will build the technical infrastructure that powers our entire partnership strategy
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role is tasked with building infrastructure and workflows from scratch to support a partnership function, an early-maturity signal despite the broader company being established.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design proactive insight pipelines by translating recurring business and partner needs into clear analytical logic, metric definitions, signal criteria, and output requirements.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities describe specific, concrete deliverables (insight pipelines, metric definitions, AI-assisted workflows) rather than generic boilerplate, indicating hiring-manager authorship.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: seeing your technical assets directly drive external partner growth and internal revenue velocity
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly centered on partnership ecosystem growth, GTM processes, and revenue operations, a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Translate ambiguous commercial and partnership problems into clear analytical plans, stakeholder-aligned requirements, and measurable deliverables.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns translating ambiguous problems into strategy (strategic) while also executing specific automation and pipeline-building tasks (execution), giving mixed autonomy.
evidence.ai_role: Apply AI- and LLM-assisted tools to improve analytical speed and quality across exploration, documentation, anomaly detection, query development, and workflow design.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use AI/LLM tools to accelerate their own analytical work, an ai_user signal, though the role also builds AI-powered automation for others, blending both signals with ai_user being the more concrete, tool-use framing.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD mentions improving data quality generally but never frames testing, contracts, or data quality frameworks as an owned practice.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely around growth, automation, and competitive advantage rather than risk, compliance, or reliability concerns.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: you will build the technical infrastructure that powers our entire partnership strategy
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role is explicitly about building new technical infrastructure and automated workflows from scratch to support a partnership function that lacks this today, a greenfield signal.
evidence.work_arrangement: This is a hybrid role based in either our New York City or Redwood City office. The successful candidate will be expected to work onsite at least three days per week.
